name: Garlic Butter Prawn Rice
blurb: A 15-minute one-pan of prawns, garlic butter and fluffy rice for one or two.
method: Melt the butter in a frying pan and soften the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the prawns and fry 2-3 minutes until pink.
Stir through the rice to heat, then finish with lemon juice and parsley.

name: Crispy Pesto Gnocchi
blurb: Pan-fried gnocchi tossed with pesto and spinach — ready in 12 minutes, one pan.
method: Fry the gnocchi in the oil over high heat for 6-8 minutes until golden and crisp.
Add the spinach and let it wilt.
Off the heat, stir through the pesto and Parmesan and serve.

name: Black Bean & Cheese Quesadilla
blurb: Store-cupboard black beans and cheese griddled in a tortilla. Ten minutes flat.
method: Mash the beans roughly with the paprika and chilli.
Spread over one tortilla, scatter with cheese and top with the second.
Griddle 2-3 minutes each side until crisp, then cut into wedges.

name: Chinese Tomato & Egg Noodles
blurb: A homely 15-minute stir-fry of soft eggs, sweet tomatoes and noodles.
method: Scramble the eggs in a hot wok until just set, then remove.
Fry the tomatoes with the sugar until saucy, season with soy.
Add cooked noodles and the eggs, toss and top with spring onion.

name: Halloumi & Harissa Flatbread
blurb: Griddled halloumi, harissa yoghurt and salad piled on warm flatbread.
method: Fry the halloumi in a dry pan until golden on both sides.
Warm the flatbreads, spread with the harissa-swirled yoghurt.
Top with leaves, cucumber and halloumi, then roll up.

name: Tuna & White Bean Salad
blurb: No-cook store-cupboard supper: tinned tuna, cannellini beans, lemon and red onion.
method: Tip the beans and tuna into a bowl.
Add the onion, lemon juice, oil and parsley.
Fold together gently, season well and serve.

name: Miso Butter Udon
blurb: Slippery udon in a glossy miso-butter sauce with spring onion. Twelve minutes.
method: Heat the udon with a splash of water in a pan.
Stir in the miso, butter and soy until it coats the noodles.
Top with spring onion and sesame.

name: Chorizo & Chickpea Skillet
blurb: Smoky chorizo, chickpeas and spinach in a tomatoey one-pan. Ready in 20.
method: Fry the chorizo until the oil runs, add the onion and soften.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and paprika and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir the spinach through to wilt and serve with bread.

name: Lemon & Parmesan Spaghetti
blurb: Spaghetti al limone — pasta, lemon, butter and Parmesan. Ten-minute comfort.
method: Cook the spaghetti, saving a mug of pasta water.
Toss the drained pasta with the butter, lemon, Parmesan and a splash of water.
Loosen to a silky sauce, season with pepper and serve.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow)
blurb: Fiery minced chicken with holy basil over rice and a fried egg. Fifteen minutes.
method: Fry the garlic and chilli briefly, add the mince and brown.
Season with the oyster sauce, soy and sugar, then stir in the basil.
Fry the eggs hard and crisp and serve on top of the chicken and rice.

name: No-Cook Caprese Orzo
blurb: Warm orzo tossed with tomatoes, mozzarella and basil — a 15-minute assembly job.
method: Cook the orzo, drain and cool slightly.
Toss with the tomatoes, oil and balsamic and season.
Fold through the mozzarella and basil just before serving.

name: Speedy Sausage & Gnocchi
blurb: Sausagemeat, gnocchi and greens in a creamy tomato pan. Twenty minutes, one pan.
method: Fry the sausagemeat in chunks with the fennel seeds until browned.
Add the tomatoes and gnocchi with a splash of water and cook 6 minutes.
Stir in the cream and kale and simmer until the kale softens.

name: Weeknight Egg Fried Rice
blurb: Cold rice, egg, peas and spring onion — the fastest 10-minute dinner going.
method: Scramble the eggs in a hot wok, then push aside.
Add the rice and peas and fry hard for 3-4 minutes.
Season with soy and sesame oil, stir through spring onions.

name: Ten-Minute Carbonara
blurb: Pasta, egg yolks, pecorino and pancetta — no cream, all speed.
method: Cook the pasta; fry the pancetta until crisp.
Whisk the eggs with the pecorino and pepper.
Toss the hot drained pasta with the pancetta, then the egg mix off the heat, loosening with pasta water.

name: Smashed Chickpea Sandwich
blurb: A no-cook lunch-for-dinner: chickpeas mashed with mayo, mustard and celery.
method: Roughly mash the chickpeas with a fork.
Stir in the mayo, mustard and celery and season.
Pile onto bread with salad leaves.

name: Gochujang Butter Noodles
blurb: Springy noodles in a sticky, spicy gochujang-butter sauce. Twelve minutes.
method: Cook the noodles and save a splash of the water.
Melt the butter with the gochujang, garlic, soy and honey.
Toss the noodles through, loosen with water, top with spring onion.

name: Any-Greens Frittata
blurb: Whatever's in the drawer, six eggs and a hot grill. Fifteen minutes, one pan.
method: Beat the eggs with seasoning and the herbs.
Warm the veg in an oven-proof pan, pour in the eggs and dot with cheese.
Cook until almost set, then finish under a hot grill until puffed.

name: Quick Chilli-Lime Prawn Tacos
blurb: Pan-fried prawns, slaw and lime crema folded into warm tortillas. Fifteen minutes.
method: Toss the prawns with the chipotle and fry 3 minutes until pink.
Mix the soured cream with lime juice and season.
Fill the warm tortillas with cabbage, prawns and lime crema.

name: 15-Minute Dan Dan Noodles
blurb: Pork mince, chilli oil, sesame and noodles in a bowl you'll want again tomorrow.
method: Fry the pork hard until crisp and browned.
Whisk the tahini, soy and chilli oil with a little noodle water for the sauce.
Cook the noodles and pak choi, then build bowls with sauce, noodles and pork.

name: Baked Feta Pasta
blurb: The internet's favourite: a block of feta and cherry tomatoes roasted into a sauce.
method: Put the feta in the middle of a dish, surround with tomatoes, oil and garlic.
Roast at 200C for 30 minutes until collapsing.
Mash together, toss with cooked pasta and basil.

name: Tomato Soup & Grilled Cheese
blurb: Blitzed tinned-tomato soup and a molten cheese toastie. The ultimate 20-minute night in.
method: Soften the onion, add the tomatoes and sugar and simmer 10 minutes, then blitz with the cream.
Butter the bread, fill with cheese and fry until golden both sides.
Serve the toastie cut in half alongside the soup.

name: Chilli Oil Fried Eggs on Rice
blurb: Crispy-edged eggs, chilli crisp, soy and spring onion over hot rice. Eight minutes.
method: Fry the eggs in hot oil until the edges are lacy and crisp.
Heat the rice and dress with soy, vinegar and half the chilli crisp.
Top with the eggs, more chilli crisp and spring onion.

name: Cold Peanut Noodle Salad
blurb: No-cook once the noodles are done: peanut-lime dressing, cucumber, carrot, herbs.
method: Soak or boil the noodles, then rinse cold.
Whisk the peanut butter with lime, soy, sriracha and a splash of water.
Toss everything together and top with coriander.

name: Ricotta Gnudi, Butter & Sage
blurb: Pillowy ricotta dumplings in nut-brown butter. Deceptively quick, quietly special.
method: Mix the ricotta, Parmesan, yolk and flour to a soft dough, shape into small ovals and dust with flour.
Simmer in salted water 2-3 minutes until they float.
Fry the sage in the butter until it foams and browns, then coat the gnudi.

name: Weeknight Shakshuka
blurb: Eggs poached in a spiced pepper-tomato sauce, straight from the pan with bread.
method: Soften the onion and pepper, add the spices for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until just set. Scatter feta and parsley.

name: Sardine, Lemon & Chilli Spaghetti
blurb: A tin of sardines, garlic, chilli and lemon become a punchy 15-minute pasta.
method: Cook the pasta.
Warm the sardine oil with the garlic and chilli, break in the sardines.
Toss with the pasta, lemon juice, parsley and a spoon of pasta water, then top with the crunchy crumbs.

name: 15-Minute Red Lentil Dhal
blurb: Red lentils, coconut and spice simmered soft while the rice cooks.
method: Simmer the lentils with the coconut milk, water and spices for 15-18 minutes, stirring.
Fry the garlic and ginger and stir through.
Finish with lime juice and serve with rice.

name: Croque Madame
blurb: Ham, cheese and béchamel toasted, crowned with a fried egg. A brisk bit of Paris.
method: Make a quick béchamel with the butter, flour and milk, season and add the mustard.
Build sandwiches with ham and Gruyère, spread the tops with béchamel and more cheese.
Grill until bubbling, then top each with a fried egg.

name: One-Pan Prawn & Tomato Orzo
blurb: Orzo cooked risotto-style with prawns and cherry tomatoes in a single pan.
method: Soften the shallot, add the orzo and toast for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer, stirring, for 10 minutes.
Stir in the prawns for the last 3 minutes, finish with lemon and dill.

name: Speedy Three-Bean Chilli
blurb: A meat-free chilli from tins and spices, done in 25 and better the next day.
method: Soften the onion, stir in the chipotle, cumin and cocoa.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Season well and serve over rice.

name: 10-Minute Teriyaki Salmon
blurb: Salmon fillets glazed in a quick teriyaki and grilled sticky. Rice and greens alongside.
method: Simmer the soy, mirin, honey and ginger to a syrup.
Brush over the salmon and grill 6-8 minutes, basting, until glazed.
Serve with rice and steamed tenderstem.

name: Garlic Mushrooms on Sourdough
blurb: Butter-fried mushrooms with garlic, thyme and a splash of cream on toast.
method: Fry the mushrooms in the butter over high heat until deep golden.
Add the garlic and thyme for a minute, then the cream.
Pile onto toasted sourdough.

name: Couscous with Roast Veg & Feta
blurb: Tray-roasted peppers and courgette folded through lemony couscous with feta.
method: Roast the veg with oil at 220C for 20 minutes.
Soak the couscous in an equal volume of boiling water for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Fold in the veg, lemon, mint and crumbled feta.

name: Chicken Katsu Sando
blurb: Crisp panko chicken, tonkatsu sauce and cabbage between soft white bread.
method: Coat the chicken in flour, egg then panko.
Shallow-fry 3-4 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Butter the bread, spread with sauce, add cabbage and chicken, press and slice.

name: Sausages with White Bean Mash
blurb: Grilled sausages over a quick garlicky butter-bean mash and greens. Twenty minutes.
method: Grill the sausages until browned all over.
Warm the beans with the garlic and butter, then mash with a splash of milk.
Wilt the spinach through the mash and serve with the sausages.

name: One-Pot Tomato Rice
blurb: Rice cooked straight in a spiced tomato base until fluffy. Minimal effort, maximum comfort.
method: Fry the cumin and onion until soft, add the garam masala.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes and water, bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook 12 minutes, add peas, rest 5 minutes, fluff.

name: Prawn & Avocado Rice Bowl
blurb: Cooked prawns, avocado, cucumber and a soy-sesame drizzle over rice. No cooking bar the rice.
method: Warm or cool the rice as you like and put in a bowl.
Arrange the prawns, avocado and cucumber on top.
Drizzle with soy, sesame oil and sriracha mayo.

name: Fridge-Raid Fried Rice
blurb: Any veg, any protein, cold rice and a hot wok. A different dinner every time.
ingredients: 200g odds and ends of veg, chopped
method: Scramble the eggs and set aside.
Stir-fry the firmer veg, then the softer veg and protein.
Add the rice, fry hard, season with the sauces, fold in the egg and spring onion.

name: Soft Polenta with Mushrooms
blurb: Creamy quick-cook polenta under garlicky mushrooms and Parmesan.
method: Whisk the polenta into the simmering stock and cook 5-8 minutes until thick, then beat in butter and Parmesan.
Fry the mushrooms with garlic and thyme until golden.
Spoon the mushrooms over the polenta.

name: 15-Minute Turkey Burgers
blurb: Quick seasoned turkey patties with a lemon-herb mayo in a bun. Lighter, still juicy.
method: Mix the mince with the onion granules, mustard and seasoning; shape 2 patties.
Fry 4-5 minutes each side until cooked through.
Mix the mayo with lemon and parsley, build the burgers with lettuce and tomato.

name: Cacio e Pepe
blurb: Just pecorino, black pepper and pasta water whipped into a glossy cloak. Purist comfort.
method: Toast the pepper in a wide pan, add a ladle of pasta water.
Cook the pasta until very al dente, move to the pan with more water.
Off the heat, add the pecorino a handful at a time, tossing hard to emulsify.

name: Nduja Butter Beans on Toast
blurb: Butter beans simmered with spicy nduja and tomato, spooned over charred bread.
method: Melt the nduja with the garlic, add the passata and beans.
Simmer 8 minutes until glossy and thick.
Spoon over toasted sourdough and finish with basil.

name: Chicken Larb Lettuce Cups
blurb: Zingy Thai minced chicken with lime, fish sauce, chilli and toasted rice in crisp lettuce.
ingredients: 1 tbsp uncooked rice, toasted and ground
method: Fry the chicken mince until cooked, breaking it up, then take off the heat.
Toss with the fish sauce, lime juice, ground rice, shallots and chilli.
Fold in the herbs and spoon into lettuce leaves.

name: Cheat's Pea & Mint Risotto
blurb: A quick oven-free risotto finished with frozen peas, mint and lemon. Twenty-five minutes.
method: Soften the shallot, add the rice and toast, then add stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 18 minutes.
Stir in the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Beat in the butter, Parmesan, mint and lemon and serve loose.

name: Bacon & Kimchi Fried Rice
blurb: Crisp bacon, tangy kimchi and cold rice fried hot, topped with a runny egg.
method: Fry the bacon until crisp, add the kimchi and cook 2 minutes.
Add the rice and gochujang and fry hard for 4 minutes, finish with sesame oil.
Top each bowl with a fried egg and spring onion.

name: Greek Chicken Pita Pockets
blurb: Quick oregano-lemon chicken, tzatziki and tomato stuffed into warm pittas.
method: Toss the chicken with oregano, lemon zest, oil and seasoning and fry 6-8 minutes.
Warm the pittas and open them out.
Fill with tzatziki, chicken, tomato and onion, squeeze over lemon.

name: Spiced Tofu Scramble Wrap
blurb: Turmeric-yellow tofu scramble with peppers and spinach rolled in a tortilla. Vegan, fast.
method: Fry the pepper for 3 minutes, add the tofu, turmeric and paprika.
Cook 5 minutes until dry and golden, then wilt in the spinach.
Pile into tortillas with hot sauce and roll up.

name: Purple Sprouting Broccoli & Anchovy Orecchiette
blurb: Broccoli cooked soft with anchovy, garlic and chilli, clinging to little pasta ears.
method: Boil the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 4 minutes.
Melt the anchovies in the oil with the garlic and chilli.
Toss the drained pasta and broccoli through, mashing some broccoli into a sauce.
